task.description:
Run the full test suite for WF02-spt-02:
1. Pre-flight: verify Docker services (db, db_test, keycloak) are up.
2. zig build (compile check)
3. zig build test (unit tests)
4. zig build test-integration (integration tests including SPT-02)
5. Write report to tests/reports/report-YYYYMMDD-WF02-spt-02.yaml

All must pass. If any service is down, return FAIL BLOCKER per protocol.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration exits 0 (all integration tests pass including SPT-02)
